sections.title: Pros
sections.narration: Positives first: slow-carb fibre backbone. The bean value comes from carbs that arrive with a lot of fibre support. Cheap shelf-stable nutrition. Dry black beans are easy to store and scale, which matters for real diets. Dark seed coat adds a polyphenol angle. The black seed coat gives them a more specific plant-compound story than plain starch.
